03a29d4872a91228.description:
You will run the public voice of a fintech company from the second month of your career, not the fifth year. Lokta is a small, founder-led team building an agentic loan servicing platform for lenders in India. Our founders are the same people who built Apache Fineract, the open-source lending core used in 70 countries. Our story is told on LinkedIn, X, and our blog. You will be the person who tells it every day.

This is an internship with a job at the end of it. If the internship works, you will convert to a full-time marketing role at Lokta. We are hiring for the full-time role; the internship is how we both find out.



1. Run the Lokta LinkedIn company page and X account: plan the content calendar, write the posts, publish them, and respond to comments.
2. Turn every blog post on lokta.ai/updates into LinkedIn text posts, single-image posts, and document carousels using our share-card design system.
3. Run the daily engagement play: find fresh posts from NBFCs, fintechs, and lending executives, draft comments in the Lokta voice, and publish them after review.
4. Track what works and what does not each week in a single sheet that the founders review, including reach, engagement, profile visits, and inbound conversations.
5. Draft using AI tools and own every edit. At Lokta, AI drafts, you decide, and your name is on the result. Every published word must meet our brand voice standards, which you will learn in your first week.
6. Learn how lending works in India: what a loan book is, why collections matter, and what an NBFC Chief Risk Officer worries about. You cannot write for this audience without understanding it, so we will teach you.
03a29d4872a91228.title: Content and Social Media Marketing

If you have hands-on experience working on real-world embedded products, you will be strongly preferred.



A. Embedded Firmware Development

1. Develop, debug, and maintain embedded firmware for STM32- and ESP32-based products.
2. Write clean, efficient, reliable C/C++ firmware.
3. Work with microcontroller peripherals including GPIO, ADC, timers, PWM, UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, and other relevant interfaces.
4. Implement and maintain device drivers, communication protocols, and hardware abstraction layers.
5. Develop firmware features, improve existing functionality, and troubleshoot hardware-software integration issues.
6. Work with RTOS-based systems where applicable.
7. Assist in developing firmware for new electronic products and prototypes.

B. Flight Controller & FPV Electronics Firmware

1. Take ownership of firmware across EDITHFPV's flight controller and electronics product range, including STM32-based flight controllers and other supported MCUs.
2. Work on ESC and 4-in-1 ESC firmware.
3. Work with ExpressLRS-compatible radio receivers and other RF electronics.
4. Develop and maintain GPS/GNSS, telemetry, and navigation-related firmware.
5. Support firmware development for other embedded electronics developed by EDITHFPV.
6. Understand existing firmware architectures and codebases.
7. Configure, build, flash, and test firmware.
8. Modify and develop firmware features as required.
9. Debug issues involving sensors, motor outputs, communication buses, power management, and peripherals.
10. Support firmware integration with flight controller hardware.
11. Maintain reliable firmware releases for production and development hardware.
12. Experience with Betaflight, Bluejay, ExpressLRS, ArduPilot, PX4, or similar embedded/drone firmware projects is an advantage.

C. Firmware Version Management & Maintenance

1. Maintain firmware repositories, source code, and release history.
2. Use Git for version control and follow proper branching and commit practices.
3. Maintain firmware versions, release notes, and change logs.
4. Track hardware revisions and ensure firmware compatibility.
5. Support firmware builds, release testing, and production firmware management.
6. Maintain documentation for firmware configuration, flashing, and troubleshooting.
7. Help establish a structured firmware development and release process.

D. Embedded UI & Tools

1. Develop and maintain user interfaces for embedded products and related configuration tools.
2. Work on embedded displays, configuration interfaces, PC utilities, or web-based tools as required.
3. Interface firmware with UI applications through serial, USB, wireless, or other communication protocols.
4. Develop tools for firmware configuration, testing, diagnostics, and product setup.
5. Assist in improving the user experience of EDITHFPV electronics products.

E. Hardware Bring-Up & Debugging

1. Work closely with the hardware design team during PCB bring-up and product development.
2. Validate microcontroller peripherals and board functionality.
3. Debug firmware and hardware issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and other laboratory equipment.
4. Perform functional testing of flight controllers, receivers, ESCs, and other embedded products.
5. Assist in identifying root causes of hardware-software integration problems.
6. Support prototype testing and production readiness.

F. Documentation & Engineering Support

1. Maintain technical documentation for firmware and embedded systems.
2. Document bugs, fixes, test results, and implementation details.
3. Collaborate with hardware engineers and other members of the product development team.
4. Support firmware deployment, testing, and after-sales technical troubleshooting when required.

442d2607ee4b0f32.description:
We are looking for a self-driven Full Stack Web Development Intern who wants hands-on experience building and deploying real-world web applications.

The intern will work on small-scale products, micro-projects, internal tools, and innovative ideas, taking ownership of tasks from development through deployment. Depending on project requirements, you will work with technologies such as React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, PHP, and MySQL.

This is not a classroom-style training internship. We provide mentorship, technical direction, and resources, but the intern is expected to research, implement, debug, and deliver solutions independently.



A. Development

1. Work on assigned development tasks, features, and project modules.
2. Build frontend interfaces using React.js, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, or Tailwind CSS.
3. Develop backend APIs and business logic using Node.js/Express.js or PHP.
4. Work with MongoDB and MySQL for database design and integration.
5. Integrate frontend, backend, APIs, and databases into functional applications.
6. Convert requirements and ideas into working features.

B. Debugging & Problem-Solving

1. Identify and resolve bugs in existing applications.
2. Debug frontend, backend, API, database, and deployment-related issues.
3. Research and troubleshoot technical problems independently before seeking assistance.
4. Optimize applications for performance, reliability, and scalability.
5. Test features thoroughly before submitting them for review.
6. Demonstrate strong debugging skills and the ability to resolve issues efficiently.

C. Git & GitHub

1. Use Git and GitHub as part of daily development workflows.
2. Commit completed work regularly with clean, descriptive commit messages.
3. Maintain proper branches where required.
4. Push code to assigned repositories and keep repositories organized.
5. Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback.
6. Maintain regular GitHub activity as part of the internship's reporting and evaluation process.

D. Deployment

1. Deploy frontend applications and backend services/APIs.
2. Configure databases, environment variables, and application settings.
3. Manage staging and production environments.
4. Troubleshoot and resolve deployment-related issues.
5. Work with platforms such as AWS, Vercel, Netlify, or Heroku, depending on project requirements.

E. Documentation

1. Maintain technical documentation for assigned projects and modules.
2. Document project overviews, setup instructions, and technologies used.
3. Document database structures and APIs.
4. Maintain environment configuration and deployment instructions.
5. Document known issues and important implementation decisions.
6. Maintain clear and up-to-date documentation as part of the formal performance evaluation.

F. Daily Communication

1. Attend assigned meetings and technical discussions.
2. Clearly communicate completed work and ongoing progress.
3. Report blockers promptly instead of waiting until deadlines.
4. Explain technical decisions and implementation approaches clearly.
5. Ask specific questions when assistance is required.
6. Provide realistic estimates for assigned tasks and deliverables.

Job Title: Recruitment Intern
Company: Aureva Capital Private Limited 
Location: Remote
Internship Duration: 3 Months (Full-Time) 

About Aureva Capital
Aureva Capital is a Mumbai-based Wealth Management and Financial Advisory firm. We are focused on empowering individuals and families to achieve their financial goals through personalized advisory, technology-driven insights, and innovative investment solutions. As we build out our next-generation digital investment platform, we are rapidly scaling our core teams. 

Role Overview
We are seeking an energetic and proactive Recruitment Intern to drive end-to-end talent acquisition across multiple functional areas, including Technology, Sales, Content Writing, and Operations. Working closely with leadership, you will play a key role in identifying, engaging, and onboarding top talent to accelerate our company’s growth.

Key Responsibilities
1. Sourcing & Pipeline Building: Actively source prospective candidates across job portals, LinkedIn, college networks, and niche talent communities for open roles in Tech, Sales, Operations, and Content.
2. Screening & Assessment: Review resumes, conduct initial screening calls to assess fit and communication, and shortlist candidates against role specifications.
3. Interview Coordination: Schedule and manage interview rounds between candidates and hiring managers/founders, ensuring a smooth, timely evaluation process.
4. Candidate Experience: Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates throughout the hiring lifecycle, maintaining transparent communication and follow-ups.
5. Job Postings & Campus Outreach: Draft and post engaging job descriptions across multiple platforms and assist with campus recruitment initiatives.
6. Recruitment Operations: Maintain internal applicant tracking data, coordinate offer rollout logistics, and support basic onboarding activities.

What We Are Looking For
• Education: Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (HR, Business Administration, Psychology, or related fields preferred).
• Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills to effectively engage and evaluate candidates.
• Multi-Domain Hiring Interest: Curiosity and quick adaptability to understand job requirements across technical (Full Stack, Data) and non-technical (Sales, Editorial, Ops) domains.
• Ownership & Drive: High energy, detail-oriented mindset, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
• Tools & Platforms: Familiarity with LinkedIn sourcing, job boards (Internshala, Naukri, Wellfound, etc.), and Google Workspace/MS Excel.

What You Will Gain
1. Hands-on, end-to-end recruitment experience across diverse business functions within a high-growth fintech environment. 
2. Direct exposure to business founders and decision-makers. 
3. Practical knowledge of tech stacks, sales metrics, and operational hiring dynamics.
4. Certificate of Internship and Letter of Recommendation (based on performance).

About the Internship

We’re looking for an AI Engineer Intern who can build AI-powered product features using modern AI application development frameworks.

This is not a machine learning research role. You won’t be expected to train models from scratch or have advanced knowledge of ML mathematics. We’re looking for someone who understands the fundamentals of building AI applications using Python, FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, Vector Databases, and RAG, and wants to apply these skills to real SaaS products.

You’ll work closely with our engineering team to build and integrate AI capabilities into existing and upcoming products.

What You’ll Do

1. Build backend services and AI APIs using Python and FastAPI.
2. Integrate LLMs and AI capabilities into SaaS products.
3. Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
4. Work with Vector Databases for embeddings, semantic search, and contextual retrieval.
5. Build LLM-powered applications using LangChain.
6. Design stateful, multi-step workflows and AI agents using LangGraph.
7. Build tool-using AI agents that interact with APIs, databases, documents, and product services.
8. Integrate LLM APIs with internal backend systems.
9. Work with structured and unstructured data, including JSON, documents, APIs, and databases.
10. Implement document ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, and generation pipelines.
11. Experiment with prompts, models, retrieval strategies, tools, and agent architectures.
12. Test AI responses for accuracy, relevance, and reliability.
13. Build prototypes and convert successful experiments into product features.
14. Write clean, maintainable, and understandable code.
15. Document and demonstrate the AI features you build.

Required Skills

1. Hands-on knowledge of Python, FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, Vector Databases, RAG, REST APIs, and JSON.
2. Comfortable building backend APIs using Python and FastAPI.
3. Experience creating LLM applications using LangChain.
4. Ability to build workflows and agents using LangGraph.
5. Understanding of and hands-on experience with RAG pipelines.
6. Ability to create embeddings and work with Vector Databases.
7. Familiarity with REST APIs, HTTP requests, and JSON.
8. Ability to debug applications and understand technical documentation.
9. Ability to independently implement solutions through experimentation.

Professional experience is not required. Projects, hackathons, college work, GitHub repositories, prototypes, and personal learning projects are all valid.

What We’re Looking For

1. Strong programming fundamentals.
2. Good problem-solving and debugging skills.
3. Ability to convert requirements into working features.
4. Curiosity about AI applications and AI agents.
5. Willingness to experiment, iterate, and learn from failures.
6. Ability to learn quickly through documentation and hands-on work.
7. A builder mindset — we value working projects over theoretical knowledge.

Seeking a "nerd" Quantitative Trading Intern with Python programming skills and craze for technical analysis. You will translate trading strategies from TradingView PineScript into modular Python code, execute rigorous historical backtests, and deploy strategies into live/paper trading environments via OpenAlgo and broker APIs.

Key Responsibilities
Script Conversion: Translate PineScript strategies and custom indicators (such as Pivot SuperTrend, ATR stops, and dynamic pivot levels) into clean, vectorized Python code using pandas, numpy, or numba.

Backtesting & Optimization: Build and execute backtests on multi-year historical data. Calculate core strategy metrics including Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, win rate, profit factor, and trade frequency.

Live Market Testing: Set up forward/paper trading environments to evaluate real-time strategy performance, latency, and signal reliability under actual market conditions.

Execution & API Integration: Connect Python strategy engines to OpenAlgo and broker APIs (e.g., Zerodha Kite, Angel One, Fyers) using Webhooks or REST endpoints.

Risk Management: Account for real-world execution friction such as slippage, transaction costs, order placement logic, and trailing stop adjustments.

This internship is offered by ZootechX, a technology venture incubated by Reflex Realty. ZootechX is a growing software development and AI solutions company based in Mumbai, working with startups, SMEs, and businesses across India and international markets.

We specialize in custom software development, websites, e-commerce platforms, mobile applications, SaaS products, AI-powered solutions, CRM & ERP systems, dashboards, and business automation.

As a Social Media & Digital Marketing Intern, your primary responsibility will be to build and grow ZootechX’s presence across social media platforms through consistent, creative, and engaging content.

You will work closely with the founders and get hands-on exposure to social media management, content creation, reels, creatives, brand building, organic growth, outreach, lead generation, and eventually paid advertising for ZootechX’s upcoming products and services.


1. Manage and grow ZootechX’s social media presence across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
2. Plan and maintain a structured monthly and weekly social media content calendar.
3. Create engaging social media creatives, posts, carousels, stories, graphics, and promotional content using Canva or similar design tools.
4. Ideate, create, edit, and publish short-form video content and reels around technology, AI, software, startups, business automation, and emerging trends.
Identify trending reel formats, hooks, audio, content styles, and topics that can improve reach and engagement.
5. Write engaging captions, hooks, CTAs, social media copy, case-study content, and promotional communication.
6. Regularly research competitor social media accounts, technology creators, SaaS companies, AI companies, and viral content formats to identify new content opportunities.
7. Track social media performance, including reach, views, engagement, followers, shares, saves, profile visits, website clicks, and leads.
8. Experiment with different content formats and continuously improve content based on performance and audience response.
9. Support ZootechX’s organic lead-generation efforts through LinkedIn, Instagram, communities, networking platforms, and other relevant channels.
10. Research potential clients, founders, startups, SMEs, agencies, consultants, and businesses that may require ZootechX’s technology services.
11. Assist with outreach through LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, social media DMs, and other communication channels.
12. Identify potential collaborations, partnerships, creators, communities, and promotional opportunities that can increase ZootechX’s visibility.
13. Coordinate with the founders, development team, design team, and sales team to convert ZootechX’s work, projects, services, and case studies into strong social media content.
14. Create and execute social media campaigns for ZootechX’s services, including websites, mobile apps, SaaS products, AI automation, CRM/ERP solutions, e-commerce, and custom software development.
15. Support the social media launch and marketing of ZootechX’s upcoming products.
Once ZootechX’s products are ready for launch, assist in planning and running Meta Ads, Instagram Ads, Google Ads, and other relevant paid campaigns.
16. Learn and support campaign setup, audience targeting, creative testing, retargeting, lead generation, budget allocation, and performance analysis for paid advertising.
17. Explore AI tools and marketing tools that can improve content creation, video production, social media management, outreach, lead generation, and marketing productivity.
18. Bring new ideas every week to improve ZootechX’s brand awareness, social media growth, engagement, inbound enquiries, and lead generation.

The ideal candidate should be creative, social-media savvy, comfortable creating reels and creatives, aware of current trends, and genuinely interested in technology, AI, startups, and digital marketing.

Knowledge of Canva and basic video editing is strongly preferred. Experience with Meta Ads or Google Ads is an advantage, but candidates who are willing to learn and take ownership of paid advertising as ZootechX launches its products are also encouraged to apply.

You will write across formats — blog posts, social media captions, LinkedIn posts, newsletter editions, ad copy drafts — under the direct mentorship of our senior writers. 



A. Social media writing:
1. Write Instagram captions, LinkedIn posts, Twitter / X threads, and Reels copy for our clients’ brand pages
2. Draft community-management replies and engagement posts
3. Build content calendars and schedule posts across Instagram, LinkedIn, and Twitter

B. Long-form & blog:
1. Research and draft blog posts (800–1500 words) for our coaching, EdTech, D2C, and wellness clients
2. Edit and proofread teammates’ drafts for grammar, tone, and clarity
3. Repurpose long-form blogs into social derivatives (carousels, threads, reels scripts)

C. Ad copy & sales writing:
1. Draft headline + primary text variations for Meta and Google ad campaigns under senior-writer review
2. Write email subject lines and short email body copy for client newsletters
3. Help build hooks for short-form video (Reels, Shorts, YouTube Shorts)

D. SEO & research:
1. Conduct keyword research for client blog topics
2. Apply on-page SEO basics — title tags, meta descriptions, H1/H2 hierarchy, internal links
3. Research industry trends, competitor content, and audience pain points

Our AI-writing policy (please read carefully):

1. ChatGPT and Claude are excellent for research, ideation, fact-checking, and structuring outlines. They are NOT a replacement for your writing voice.
2. What is allowed: Using AI for research, brainstorming angles, finding statistics, building content briefs, and editing for grammar.
3. What is NOT allowed: Submitting AI-generated copy as your own writing. We test for AI-generated drafts in our writing exercise. Candidates who submit AI-written portfolios will be filtered out.
4. If you can’t write a 200-word paragraph without ChatGPT, this internship isn’t for you yet. Spend three months writing on your own first, then apply.

Eklavya is an educational platform offering interactive learning games and activities for children aged 3–12. We are looking for a detail-oriented Game Tester to thoroughly evaluate our games for functionality, educational accuracy, usability, and age appropriateness.



1. Play and thoroughly test educational games across multiple levels.
2. Understand each game's learning objective, rules, and expected behaviour before testing.
3. Verify gameplay logic, correct answers, scoring, lives, timers, hints, rewards, and completion conditions.
4. Check whether instructions are clear and understandable for the intended age group.
5. Evaluate whether the difficulty level is appropriate for the assigned grade.
6. Verify educational content, spelling, grammar, images, audio, and answer accuracy.
7. Test games across different devices, browsers, screen sizes, and orientations.
8. Identify and test critical and edge-case scenarios.
9. Identify gameplay, content, usability, performance, and device-specific issues.
10. Report bugs with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, severity, device details, screenshots, and screen recordings.
11. Retest resolved issues and verify that fixes do not introduce new problems.
12. Suggest improvements to make games clearer, more engaging, and easier for children to use.

Important

We are not looking for someone who will simply play each game once and mark it as working. The selected tester must examine games carefully, test unusual actions and edge cases, verify educational content, and assess whether children in the intended age group can understand and use the games independently.
80f1d1ba9e510f7a.title: Educational Game Tester

4. Micro-Interactions & Transitions: Create fluid gestures, route transitions, and responsive feedback using animation libraries such as Framer Motion for web and React Native Reanimated for mobile.

3. Performance & Quality

Company: Aureva Capital Private Limited 
Location: Ghatkopar West, Mumbai (In-office) 
Internship Duration: 3 Months (Full-Time)

Aureva Capital is a Mumbai-based Wealth Management and Financial Advisory firm. We are focused on empowering individuals and families to achieve their financial goals through personalized advisory, technology-driven insights, and innovative investment solutions. As we build out our next-generation digital investment platform, we are rapidly scaling our core teams. 

Role Overview
We are seeking an energetic and proactive Recruitment Intern to drive end-to-end talent acquisition across multiple functional areas, including Technology, Sales, Content Writing, and Operations. Working closely with leadership, you will play a key role in identifying, engaging, and onboarding top talent to accelerate our company’s growth.

5. Job Postings & Campus Outreach: Draft and post engaging job descriptions across multiple platforms and assist with campus recruitment initiatives.
6. Recruitment Operations: Maintain internal applicant tracking data, coordinate offer rollout logistics, and support basic onboarding activities.

What We Are Looking For
• Education: Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (HR, Business Administration, Psychology, or related fields preferred).
• Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills to effectively engage and evaluate candidates.
• Multi-Domain Hiring Interest: Curiosity and quick adaptability to understand job requirements across technical (Full Stack, Data) and non-technical (Sales, Editorial, Ops) domains.
• Ownership & Drive: High energy, detail-oriented mindset, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
• Tools & Platforms: Familiarity with LinkedIn sourcing, job boards (Internshala, Naukri, Wellfound, etc.), and Google Workspace/MS Excel.

What You Will Gain

About Suvitt:

Suvitt is a virtual CFO, governance, and compliance advisory firm working with growing companies and family businesses. We function like a fractional CFO office, covering MIS and dashboards, payroll, statutory compliance, transaction structuring, and founder-office support. We are building internal systems (Freshdesk-based operations, structured reporting, knowledge capture) that let our team run reliably without one person having to remember and chase everything.

The Role:

We are hiring an intern to own the plumbing between our operational tools—Freshdesk, Outlook/Microsoft 365, and our knowledge-capture systems (Notion/OneNote)—and to bring disciplined AI usage into our daily reporting and workflows. This is not a “build me an AI chatbot” role. It is a systems and process role in which AI is one tool among several, used carefully and only where it adds real value.

You will start with real, contained problems (cleaning up Freshdesk reporting, designing an email-to-notes capture pipeline) and grow into owning the automation layer across our practice.



1. Migrate our daily and weekly Freshdesk reports (SLA breach dashboards, statutory deadline tracking, exception alerts) from ad-hoc AI-run tasks to reliable, scheduled, auditable pipelines.
2. Design and build an email-to-notes capture system so that important team emails flow into a shared knowledge base (Notion or OneNote) without duplicating what Freshdesk already tracks.
3. Work with APIs, webhooks, and no-code/low-code tools (Power Automate, Make, n8n, or Zapier) to connect our systems.
4. Write documentation and runbooks that a non-technical team lead can follow.
5. Use AI (Claude, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Copilot) thoughtfully—for summarisation and classification, never for numbers, dates, or decisions that carry client risk.
6. Track and reduce the cost and credit footprint of our AI-assisted workflows.
